script: Her weekly tea ritual with her night driver hid a shocking secret about his true intentions. Every Tuesday, an elderly woman would offer her regular night driver a warm cup of tea for the journey home. It was a small act of kindness she never thought twice about. One evening, after weeks of this routine, the driver suddenly missed her usual exit, taking a dark, unfamiliar road. Confused and a little scared, she asked why. He pulled over, turned, and in a low voice said, "I needed to talk to you, ma'am. I'm losing my home, and I didn't know who else to ask." Her simple kindness had become his only hope, revealing the hidden struggles people carry, often right beside us. It was a shocking secret hidden within her weekly tea ritual with her night driver.
